description: Out-of-domain check of the Phase 3 best layouts (D4 kept Wikipedia only for the search). Two news collections from the public ban-dataset-collection (fetch-data, prepare-data), read in place and never modified. Same normalization (bangla-dh-text-v1) and split rule as corpus-v1; paragraphs deduplicated within each dataset; titles are not used (as for Wikipedia). Both scrapes dropped line breaks between sentences, so a sentence mark glued to a Bangla letter gets a space. BARD shares most of its sentences with the newspaper collection, so only its documents that share no sentence with it are used (bard-novel).

split.rule: held-out if int(sha256(salt + ':' + dataset + ':' + document_id)[:8], 16) % 100 < heldout_percent

datasets.name: bard-novel
datasets.label: BARD news articles (economy, entertainment, international, sports, state) that share no sentence with the newspaper set

search.note: Same annealing + iterated local search settings as Phase 3, half the seeds, no confirmation runs; it measures how much a news-trained layout gains over the Wikipedia-trained one.
